question_cn: 象马对光杆王，将死只能发生在哪种角落？
question_en: Bishop and knight vs. lone king — checkmate can only happen in which type of corner?

options.text_cn: 只能在与象同色的角落将死
options.text_en: Only in a corner of the same color as the bishop

options.text_cn: 只能在与象异色的角落将死
options.text_en: Only in a corner of opposite color to the bishop

explanation_cn: 颜色匹配是象马残局的核心元思维。象控制同色格，将死必须发生在象能覆盖的角格。如果对方王跑到异色角，必须先把王赶到同色角，再完成将杀。
explanation_en: Color matching is the key meta-concept: the bishop controls squares of one color, so checkmate must happen in a corner of the same color as the bishop.
